setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays C, C, C, D over 16 steps at 90 BPM: step 13 has Note D3 (62) and Vel 50, the other trigs use C3 at 80. Channel 2, pattern 2 and a second MIDI output are still to be set up.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Pattern 2 starts empty. Tap Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 2 at (2,1) and tap (1,4) and (9,4) for two trigs. PATTERN TRIG PAT02 CH01 shows the two trigs as bright squares on steps 1 and 9, and the tooltip reads Pattern 2 selected.
steps.title: Enter two bass trigs

steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8) again to open the note view, then tap (1,7) for degree 0 on step 1 and (9,3) for degree 4 on step 9. PATTERN NOTE PAT02 shows the tooltip Step 9 note set to 4. Only those two note taps are yours: the bright band along row 7 is the note view's degree 0 baseline, and the extra pad at (13,6) is not one of your notes and does not play. It is the note view also showing what channel 1 last played on step 13, D3 (degree 1); pattern 2 has no trig there.
steps.title: Give them notes

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), select channel 2 at (2,1), turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 until Device is highlighted and press K3, as in chapter 2. DEVICE CH02 opens with its own Device row: channel 2 needs its own output, different from channel 1's.
steps.title: Open channel 2's Device page

steps.caption: Turn E3 one detent to CC Device, turn E2 down to MIDI channel and E3 one detent to CC2, turn E2 down to MIDI port and E3 one detent to OUT 2, then press K3 to apply. DEVICE CH02 lists Device CC Device, MIDI channel CC2 and MIDI port OUT 2, and the last line reads OK.
steps.title: Apply the second output

steps.caption: Tap (2,2) to give channel 2 pattern 2. MERGE MODES for CH02 shows Patterns 02 and the tooltip reads Pattern 2 added to ch. 2.
steps.title: Assign pattern 2

steps.caption: Set the range, a gesture and not a trig: hold (1,4), tap (16,4) and release (1,4), so channel 2 loops the same 16 steps as channel 1. The tooltip reads Channel 2 length changed.
steps.title: Loop 16 steps

steps.caption: Tap (9,8) for octave -1. The screen reads NOTE MASKS CH02 OCT-1 and the tooltip shows Ch. 2 octave: -1; (2,2) and (9,8) are lit.
steps.title: Drop it an octave

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two passes run, then tap Play to stop. While it plays the screen stays on NOTE MASKS CH02 OCT-1 and the Play pad (1,8) is lit. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 on port 1: notes 60, 60, 60 at velocity 80 and 62 at velocity 50, a beat apart. Channel 2 is on port 2: note 48 on step 1 and note 55 on step 9, both at velocity 100. That is the phrase above a low C and G.
steps.title: Hear the two parts

steps.caption: Optional detour. Select channel 1 at (1,1) and tap pattern slot (2,2) to add pattern 2 next to pattern 1: MERGE MODES shows Patterns 01 02 and Strategy SKIP, the default. Play two passes and stop. Skip plays a step only when exactly one assigned pattern has a trig there, so with both patterns trigging steps 1 and 9, only steps 5 and 13 stay bright on row 4. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding only 60 and 62 at velocity 50; the bass (48, 55) is unchanged.
steps.title: Add pattern 2 to channel 1 (Skip)

steps.caption: Tap (14,8) once. MERGE MODES shows Strategy ONLY with the tooltip ONLY APPLIED, and the (14,8) button changes brightness. The button steps through Skip, Only, All and further strategies. Only plays a step only when more than one assigned pattern has a trig there: on row 4 just steps 1 and 9 stay bright.
steps.title: Press the merge button once

steps.caption: Play two passes and stop, with Strategy still ONLY. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding only note 60 at velocity 80, on steps 1 and 9, two beats apart; the bass (48, 55) is unchanged. These are exactly the steps Skip silenced.
steps.title: Hear Only

steps.caption: Tap (14,8) once more: Strategy reads ALL and all four trigs on row 4 light again. Play two passes and stop. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding 60, 60, 60, 62 (velocity 80, 80, 80, 50): channel 1's Note and Vel masks supply the pitch and velocity, whichever pattern's trig fires.
steps.title: Merge mode All

steps.caption: Tap (2,2) to remove pattern 2 from channel 1, then play two passes and stop. MERGE MODES now shows Patterns 01. Channel 1 plays pattern 1 alone, 60, 60, 60, 62, and channel 2 keeps 48 and 55. Strategy stays on ALL, which makes no difference with one pattern. Another tap of (14,8) would move on to a different strategy this course does not use, so leave it.
steps.title: Remove pattern 2 again
